messages:
maya (PM): quick sync — customer asks for model-pinning + rollout controls. do we ship API-only (devs unblock fast) or prioritize a Console surface for enterprise buyers?

alex (Eng): API-first is ~2 sprints with existing endpoints. Console UI + backend glue is another 1-2 sprints.

sam (DevEx): +1 for API-first. reduces dev friction and lets integrations ship. but we need good docs + a clear example repo.

li (Product): concerned about sales objections — enterprises expect a UI for audit and rollout. can we do a minimal Console "admin view" after API GA?

reza (Sales): real ask from two Fortune customers: they want an admin UI before procurement. API-only makes procurement slower.

anya (PM): throwing RICE numbers to ground the convo — rough, but useful:
```
R: 7 (enterprise ARR influence)
I: 6 (will improve conversion / procurement)
C: 3 (engineering effort relative)
E: 4 (confidence)
Score = (R*I*E)/C = (7*6*4)/3 = 56
```
This is for API-first + docs. Console-first full UI is roughly same R but C=6 so score ~28.

alex (Eng): that math sounds right. other technical constraint: Console needs RBAC & audit logs wired to KMS which is nontrivial for Private customers.

sam (DevEx): pragmatic plan: API-first GA with sample Console admin prototype in the repo. follow-up sprint to ship a lean Console panel (view-only + pin controls) gated by enterprise flag.

maya (PM): proposal: 1) API-first public, docs + example app; 2) ship Console "admin lite" behind feature flag for Dedicated/Private in sprint+2; 3) sales playbook for customers needing UI now (pilot offer). thoughts?

reza (Sales): that would unblock most deals if we offer a pilot + timeline. :thumbsup:

li (Product): add launch criteria: API GA (docs, SDK sample, E2E test), Console-lite (view + pin + audit event), success metric = 3 pilot signups or 2 deals progressed within 30 days.

maya (PM): great. I'll update the roadmap ticket with RICE numbers, launch criteria, and a sequencing PRD. tagging @deploy-bot to post the decision to the roadmap channel.

deploy-bot: Decision posted to #product-roadmap: API-first + Console-lite behind feature flag; follow-up check-in in 6 weeks.
